# `deepseek-harness` and `dsh-plugin` are the discovery channels that matter: the DSH
# plugin ecosystem is indexed by the `dsh-plugin` topic and searched by the npm
# `deepseek-harness` keyword. The bare token `dsh` collides with many unrelated projects,
# so the description must also contain the unambiguous phrase "DeepSeek Harness".
